sections.name: PremiumDashboardView (part 1)
sections.title: Welcome banner, live clock and habit totals
sections.what: Shows Welcome Back with the user's name, a fixed motivational quote, and a clock that ticks every second with the timezone name. Until the first tick the clock shows a fixed placeholder time. Behind the scenes it also counts completed habits for each day for the heatmap.
sections.why: Likely reason: a personal welcome with the current local time, and the heatmap data is prepared up front.
sections.watch_out: The one second timer is stopped when the screen closes, so keep that cleanup step if the timer code is changed.

sections.name: PremiumDashboardView (part 2)
sections.title: Habits, focus card and heatmap
sections.what: Shows the life score, up to three active habits in a scrollable box, a focus card with a 50 minute button, and a 365 day heatmap of completed habits. The insights widget sits just above these cards.
sections.why: Likely reason: a compact daily view that puts habits and the focus start next to each other.
sections.watch_out: Only the first three active habits are shown, even though the badge counts every active habit.

summary: The Premium dashboard: a welcome banner with a live clock, the AI insights widget, life score, active habits, a 50 minute focus button and a 365 day habit heatmap.
purpose: Gives a richer daily overview of habits and focus, with a clock that updates every second.
why: Likely reason: a personal welcome and daily habit view, separate from the Home Base layout.
how: The component reads profile, tasks, habits and the focus and tab actions from the store. A one second timer keeps the clock current. It counts how many habits were completed on each day, then draws the banner, insights, life score, habits, focus card and heatmap in order.
inputs: Store data: profile, tasks, habits and the actions for starting focus and changing tab. No props.
outputs: The dashboard screen. The focus button starts a 50 minute timer. Nothing is saved.
risks: The clock shows a fixed placeholder time until the first tick. Only three active habits appear even though the badge counts them all. Several imports are unused, such as Moon, Zap and Award.
debug: If the clock does not move, check the one second timer effect. If the heatmap is empty, check the completion history on each habit. If the habit count and list disagree, that is expected because only three are shown.
